title: rust-mutants touched v1
description: What the guards of an instrumented tree recorded on the run that verified its baseline: which of each target's tests reached which mutation, which sites were reached where nothing named a test, and which targets said nothing this run can route by. A target absent from `targets` and named in `limitations` is one every test of which reaches every mutation in it.

targets.description: Every target whose guards recorded, by identity.

limitations.description: Why a target the run built is not in `targets`, as `<limitation>:<target>`.

target.description: What one target's guards recorded, and which of its tests ran to record it.

tests.description: The dense catalog indices each named test of this target reached.

loose.description: The indices reached where nothing named a test, which therefore reach every test of the target.

ran.description: Every test the baseline ran, which is what a loose site reaches.
